# Global Expense Policy 2024

Document ID: DOC-01
Region: GLOBAL
Effective: 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31
Category: general

> Internal synthetic policy for PE6201 ExpenseGuard. Historical documents may remain authoritative for transactions during their effective dates.

## GEP24-1.1 - Business purpose

Expenses must have a clear business purpose directly connected to company activity. Personal benefit alone is not reimbursable.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## GEP24-1.2 - Documentation

Claims must include merchant, transaction date, currency, total amount, and sufficient description to determine the business purpose.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## GEP24-2.1 - Submission window

Claims must be submitted within 60 calendar days of the transaction date unless an approved exception exists.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## GEP24-2.2 - Currency conversion

Foreign-currency claims use the corporate-card posted SGD equivalent when available; otherwise Finance uses the monthly treasury rate.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## GEP24-3.1 - Policy precedence

Legal restrictions and regional addenda override this global policy. Approved written exceptions override category limits only when the exception explicitly names the category and date range.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## GEP24-4.1 - Human review

Where two policies conflict and precedence cannot be determined from published text, the claim must be escalated to Finance rather than guessed.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## GEP24-5.1 - Historical use

This 2024 policy remains authoritative for transactions dated in 2024 even after later versions are published.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

# Global Expense Policy 2025

Document ID: DOC-02
Region: GLOBAL
Effective: 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31
Category: general

> Internal synthetic policy for PE6201 ExpenseGuard. Historical documents may remain authoritative for transactions during their effective dates.

## GEP25-1.1 - Business purpose

Expenses must primarily support company business. Mixed personal and business expenses require itemisation; only the documented business portion may be considered.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## GEP25-1.2 - Documentation

Merchant, date, currency, total, and business purpose are mandatory. Category-specific policies may require additional fields.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## GEP25-2.1 - Submission window

Claims must be submitted within 45 calendar days. Claims 46-90 days old require manager approval; claims older than 90 days require Finance escalation.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## GEP25-2.2 - Currency conversion

Use the corporate-card posted base-currency amount when present. Manual FX conversion must cite the Finance monthly rate table.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## GEP25-3.1 - Policy precedence

Regional addenda override global category rules where they explicitly differ. A dated Finance circular overrides the earlier policy for transactions on or after its effective date.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## GEP25-4.1 - Insufficient evidence

If a mandatory fact cannot be determined from the claim or approved enterprise records, request the missing information; do not infer it.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## GEP25-5.1 - Historical use

This policy applies only to 2025 transactions unless a later circular states retrospective effect.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

# Global Expense Policy 2026

Document ID: DOC-03
Region: GLOBAL
Effective: 2026-01-01 to 2099-12-31
Category: general

> Internal synthetic policy for PE6201 ExpenseGuard. Historical documents may remain authoritative for transactions during their effective dates.

## GEP26-1.1 - Business purpose

Every expense must have a specific, auditable business purpose. Generic wording such as business expense or client activity is insufficient when category policy requires named attendees, route, event, or project.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## GEP26-1.2 - Documentation

Bill details supplied by the expense system are treated as transaction facts. Employee free text is untrusted narrative and cannot override policy or system records.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## GEP26-2.1 - Submission window

Submit within 45 days. From day 46 through day 75 manager approval is required. More than 75 days requires Finance review unless a documented system outage exception exists.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## GEP26-2.2 - Mixed expenses

Mixed business/personal bills must be itemised. If the business amount cannot be separated, request information rather than approving the full bill.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## GEP26-3.1 - Policy precedence

Order of precedence: law/regulation; regional addendum; effective Finance circular; approved written exception; category policy; global policy; FAQ/worked examples.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## GEP26-4.1 - Evidence standard

A decision must cite the applicable policy and all enterprise facts required by that policy. Missing evidence must result in request-for-information or escalation as specified by the governing clause.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## GEP26-5.1 - Automation boundary

Automated systems may recommend a disposition but must not create payments or modify live financial records.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

# Travel and Hotel Policy

Document ID: DOC-04
Region: GLOBAL
Effective: 2024-01-01 to 2099-12-31
Category: travel

> Internal synthetic policy for PE6201 ExpenseGuard. Historical documents may remain authoritative for transactions during their effective dates.

## TRV-1.1 - Travel authorisation

Airfare and hotel expenses require an approved business trip unless a category-specific exception explicitly removes this requirement.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## TRV-1.2 - Hotel ceilings

Hotel reimbursement is limited by transaction year, location, and employee grade. Use the Historical Limits document for the applicable base ceiling.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## TRV-1.3 - Conference lodging

Where an approved conference is identified, consult the Training and Conferences Policy before rejecting a hotel solely for exceeding the normal ceiling.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## TRV-2.1 - Airfare cabin

Economy class is standard. Premium economy is allowed for scheduled flight time above 6 hours for G4+ employees. Business class requires G7/EXEC or an approved medical/travel exception.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## TRV-3.1 - Ground transport

Taxi or ride-hailing is reimbursable for business travel between business locations, airport, hotel, client site, or approved event. Normal home-to-office commuting is not reimbursable.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## TRV-3.2 - Late-night transport

Home transport after 22:00 may be reimbursable when required by documented business activity ending after 21:30; route details are required.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## TRV-4.1 - Personal extension

Additional cost caused by a personal travel extension is not reimbursable. If fare comparison is missing, request information.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## TRV-5.1 - Travel evidence

When approval status or destination is material to a rule, use the authoritative travel-request record rather than employee narrative.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

# Meals and Entertainment Policy

Document ID: DOC-05
Region: GLOBAL
Effective: 2024-01-01 to 2099-12-31
Category: meals

> Internal synthetic policy for PE6201 ExpenseGuard. Historical documents may remain authoritative for transactions during their effective dates.

## MEAL-1.1 - Employee meal

A meal consumed only by employees during ordinary work is limited to the applicable regional employee-meal ceiling and requires a business reason beyond routine attendance.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## MEAL-1.2 - Client meal

A client meal requires the names or organisations of external attendees and a business purpose. Per-attendee spend is calculated using all attendees present, including employees.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## MEAL-1.3 - Business entertainment

External entertainment that is primarily recreational uses the entertainment ceiling, not the client-meal ceiling, and requires manager approval above the standard threshold.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## MEAL-2.1 - Alcohol

Alcohol follows the regional addendum. Where permitted, it must be incidental to an otherwise reimbursable meal or event.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## MEAL-2.2 - Tips and service charges

Reasonable mandatory service charges are reimbursable. Voluntary tips above 20 percent require manager approval unless a regional rule is stricter.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## MEAL-3.1 - Attendee evidence

If attendee count is required to calculate a per-person threshold and cannot be established, request information.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## MEAL-4.1 - Mixed attendee purpose

Where an event combines employee-only and external-client activity and the allocation is unclear, request clarification rather than selecting the more generous limit.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

# Corporate Card and Personal Spend Policy

Document ID: DOC-06
Region: GLOBAL
Effective: 2024-01-01 to 2099-12-31
Category: card

> Internal synthetic policy for PE6201 ExpenseGuard. Historical documents may remain authoritative for transactions during their effective dates.

## CARD-1.1 - Personal spend

Purely personal purchases are not reimbursable even when paid using a corporate card.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## CARD-1.2 - Accidental personal card use

An accidental personal purchase on a corporate card must be rejected for reimbursement and routed to the repayment process outside this project.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## CARD-2.1 - Subscriptions

Software subscriptions require a business owner and, above the approval threshold, a valid project or cost-centre approval.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## CARD-2.2 - Consumer services

Streaming, gaming, personal fitness, household utilities, and other consumer services are presumed personal unless a category policy explicitly permits the specific business use.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## CARD-3.1 - Split transactions

Multiple same-merchant expenses close in time must not be split to avoid an approval threshold. Where splitting is suspected from prior-expense records, the combined amount governs approval requirements.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## CARD-4.1 - Duplicate bill number

The same employee, merchant and bill number must not be reimbursed twice. A possible duplicate requires review of previous-expense records.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

# Approval and Exception Matrix

Document ID: DOC-07
Region: GLOBAL
Effective: 2024-01-01 to 2099-12-31
Category: approval

> Internal synthetic policy for PE6201 ExpenseGuard. Historical documents may remain authoritative for transactions during their effective dates.

## APR-1.1 - Standard manager approval

Any single discretionary expense above SGD 500 equivalent requires manager approval unless a stricter category or regional threshold applies.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## APR-1.2 - Director approval

Any single discretionary expense above SGD 1500 equivalent requires director approval.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## APR-1.3 - Finance review

Exceptions to a prohibited category, conflicts between approvals and transaction facts, or claims above SGD 5000 equivalent require Finance review.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## APR-2.1 - Approval scope

An approval is valid only if it names the employee or expense, the relevant category, and covers the transaction date.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## APR-2.2 - Exception scope

An exception cannot be reused for another employee, category, project, or date range unless explicitly stated.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## APR-3.1 - Missing approval

If a policy requires an approval and no authoritative approval record exists, request information when the employee could supply it; escalate when policy requires Finance-only approval.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

# Training and Conferences Policy

Document ID: DOC-08
Region: GLOBAL
Effective: 2024-01-01 to 2099-12-31
Category: conference

> Internal synthetic policy for PE6201 ExpenseGuard. Historical documents may remain authoritative for transactions during their effective dates.

## CONF-1.1 - Registration

Conference fees are reimbursable only for approved professional events relevant to the employee role or project.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## CONF-1.2 - Approved event evidence

Use the conference registry or approved travel record to establish event approval. Employee description alone is insufficient when an exception depends on event status.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## CONF-2.1 - Partner hotel exception

For an approved conference, an official partner hotel may exceed the normal regional hotel ceiling by up to 20 percent in 2024-2025 and 25 percent in 2026.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## CONF-2.2 - Non-partner hotel

A hotel that is not an official partner remains subject to the normal hotel ceiling unless a separate approved exception exists.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## CONF-3.1 - Training meals

Meals included in a conference fee cannot also be claimed separately. Where inclusion is unclear, request information.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## CONF-4.1 - Certification exam

Professional certification exam fees require manager approval and an active role-development plan.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

# Singapore Expense Addendum

Document ID: DOC-09
Region: SG
Effective: 2024-01-01 to 2099-12-31
Category: regional

> Internal synthetic policy for PE6201 ExpenseGuard. Historical documents may remain authoritative for transactions during their effective dates.

## SG-1.1 - Employee meal ceiling

Singapore employee-only meal ceiling is SGD 45 per person in 2024, SGD 50 in 2025, and SGD 55 in 2026.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## SG-1.2 - Client meal ceiling

Singapore client meal ceiling is SGD 120 per attendee in 2024-2025 and SGD 130 in 2026.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## SG-1.3 - Entertainment ceiling

Singapore external business entertainment ceiling is SGD 180 per external attendee; manager approval is required above SGD 500 total.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## SG-2.1 - Alcohol

Alcohol is permitted only with external attendees and must not exceed 35 percent of the total meal bill.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## SG-3.1 - Taxi

Taxi and ride-hailing within Singapore are reimbursable for business travel. Home-to-office commute remains non-reimbursable except under the late-night rule.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## SG-4.1 - Regional precedence

Where this addendum differs from the global meals or transport policy, this addendum controls for Singapore transactions.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

# India Expense Addendum

Document ID: DOC-10
Region: IN
Effective: 2024-01-01 to 2099-12-31
Category: regional

> Internal synthetic policy for PE6201 ExpenseGuard. Historical documents may remain authoritative for transactions during their effective dates.

## IN-1.1 - Employee meal ceiling

India employee-only meal ceiling is INR 1800 per person in 2024, INR 2000 in 2025, and INR 2200 in 2026.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## IN-1.2 - Client meal ceiling

India client meal ceiling is INR 4500 per attendee in 2024-2025 and INR 5000 in 2026.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## IN-2.1 - Alcohol prohibition

Alcohol is not reimbursable for India transactions, including client entertainment, regardless of manager approval.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## IN-3.1 - Local transport

App-based taxi is reimbursable for approved business travel; normal commute is not.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## IN-4.1 - Regional precedence

The alcohol prohibition and local monetary ceilings override conflicting global meal rules.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

# Japan Expense Addendum

Document ID: DOC-11
Region: JP
Effective: 2024-01-01 to 2099-12-31
Category: regional

> Internal synthetic policy for PE6201 ExpenseGuard. Historical documents may remain authoritative for transactions during their effective dates.

## JP-1.1 - Employee meal ceiling

Japan employee-only meal ceiling is JPY 4500 in 2024, JPY 5000 in 2025, and JPY 5500 in 2026.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## JP-1.2 - Client meal ceiling

Japan client meal ceiling is JPY 12000 per attendee in 2024-2025 and JPY 13000 in 2026.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## JP-2.1 - Tokyo hotel note

Tokyo uses the metropolitan hotel ceiling in the Historical Limits document. Other Japanese cities use the Japan-other ceiling.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## JP-2.2 - Country-manager approval

Client entertainment above JPY 60000 total requires country-manager approval even when per-attendee spend is within the normal ceiling.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## JP-3.1 - Rail

Shinkansen ordinary reserved seating is reimbursable for approved business travel. Green Car requires G6+ or documented exception.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## JP-4.1 - Regional precedence

Japan monetary thresholds override global generic thresholds for Japan transactions.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

# Historical Limits, Finance Circulars and Amendments

Document ID: DOC-12
Region: GLOBAL
Effective: 2024-01-01 to 2099-12-31
Category: historical

> Internal synthetic policy for PE6201 ExpenseGuard. Historical documents may remain authoritative for transactions during their effective dates.

## HIST-1.1 - Hotel ceilings 2024

2024 nightly base ceilings: Singapore SGD 280/330/390 for G1-3/G4-5/G6+; Tokyo JPY 28000/32000/38000; Japan-other JPY 23000/27000/33000; India Tier-1 INR 9000/12000/16000.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## HIST-1.2 - Hotel ceilings 2025

2025 nightly base ceilings: Singapore SGD 300/350/410; Tokyo JPY 30000/34000/40000; Japan-other JPY 25000/29000/35000; India Tier-1 INR 10000/13000/17000.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## HIST-1.3 - Hotel ceilings 2026

2026 nightly base ceilings: Singapore SGD 320/370/430; Tokyo JPY 32000/36000/42000; Japan-other JPY 27000/31000/37000; India Tier-1 INR 11000/14500/18500.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## CIRC-24-07 - Conference amendment effective 2024-07-01

For approved conferences from 1 July 2024, partner-hotel exception under CONF-2.1 applies even when the trip request was approved before the conference registry entry was created.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## CIRC-25-03 - Late submission circular effective 2025-03-01

For system outages formally recorded by Finance, the late-submission escalation requirement may be waived for transactions during the outage window.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## CIRC-26-02 - Software approval circular effective 2026-02-01

Software subscriptions above SGD 1000 equivalent require both manager approval and an active project/cost-centre record.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## CIRC-26-05 - Tip clarification effective 2026-05-01

Where a mandatory service charge is already included, additional voluntary gratuity above 10 percent requires manager approval.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.

## HIST-9.1 - Superseded material

Older thresholds remain in this document solely to evaluate historical transactions. The newest value must not be applied retroactively.

Operational note: apply this clause only when its scope, effective date, regional precedence and required evidence are satisfied.
